subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: What it means to be part of a family and how to look after the family

show.line: In a family we help and love each other. I can help too!

rounds.prompt: Which child is helping at home?
Baby is crying. What can you do?
rounds.praise: Kind! A song helps baby feel better.

rounds.prompt: How can you help your family? Tell me one way.
Kind or not kind? Sort them.

rounds.story: Thabo's mama is tired after work. Thabo brings her a cup of water. How does mama feel?

rounds.prompt: When someone helps you, what do you say?

hints: Helping and being kind looks after the family.
Think how the other person feels.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will help my family.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I leave my toys all over the floor!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Helping means packing away my toys.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's pack away together. That helps the family!

parent_line: Can name ways to help and care for family members.
